I've been trying to be there for them without overstepping.\"],[15,\"supporter\",\"It must be tough to see someone you care about go through a hard time. How are you handling being supportive without taking on too much yourself?\"],[16,\"seeker\",\"I try to listen and offer support when I can but also remind myself that their journey is separate from mine, and I need to set limits for my own well-being.\"],[17,\"supporter\",\"That's a healthy approach. True... I guess part of me feels that by sharing my journey, it might help others, but I feel vulnerable being so open.
